description: 面向 Agent 自主组合的扩展提示词库：覆盖全部 10 个扩展风格与 6 个高频主库风格，每条提供完整中英文模板及按视觉维度拆分的 modular_tokens，便于跨风格精准抽取局部维度而不整段冲突堆叠。
usage_rules: 单风格任务可直接使用 style_en / style_zh 与 composition / lighting / palette / negative。
跨风格自主组合时，从主风格读取 layout_tokens + geometry_tokens（及核心 style_en），从辅助风格仅抽取 1–2 个维度（如 material_tokens 或 treatment_tokens），并合并 identity_guard 与 negative。
重要中英文标题、编号和品牌名建议留白或后期排版，避免依赖生图模型直接渲染文字。

prompts.subject_example: 战斗姿态角色海报 / 工业设计展主视觉
prompts.style_en: [subject], Russian Constructivist graphic poster, bold single diagonal axis, asymmetric dynamic composition, geometric wedges and circles, monumental condensed sans-serif typography, photomontage cutouts, high-contrast flat print blocks
prompts.style_zh: [主体]，俄罗斯构成主义平面海报，单一主导对角线轴，非对称动势构图，楔形与圆环几何模块，粗重纪念碑式无衬线大字，摄影蒙太奇裁切，高反差平涂色块
prompts.composition: single dominant diagonal or radial axis, asymmetric balance / 单一主导对角线或放射轴，非对称平衡
prompts.lighting: flat high-contrast graphic print lighting, no glossy 3D shading / 平面高反差印刷光效，无写实高光
prompts.palette: signal red, deep black, warm off-white cream paper / 信号红、深黑、暖米白纸底
prompts.negative: multiple competing diagonals, soft pastel gradients, 3D glossy render, cluttered background, garbled text / 多条竞争斜线、柔和粉彩渐变、3D高光渲染、杂乱背景、乱码文字
prompts.compatibility: 通用（MJ / SD / Flux）；海报文字建议后期排版
prompts.tips: 只保留一条主导斜线，不要把所有元素都倾斜；红黑米白是经典组合但并非唯一选择

geometry_tokens: geometric wedges, rings and sharp rectangular blocks
palette_tokens: signal red, deep black and warm cream paper
modular_tokens.identity_guard: preserve character silhouette, face and key costume markers despite geometric cropping

prompts.subject_example: 抽象几何角色属性卡 / 现代建筑展海报
prompts.style_en: [subject], De Stijl neoplasticist graphic design, strict horizontal and vertical black lines, asymmetric rectangular modules, balanced negative space, flat primary color planes, crisp modernist abstraction
prompts.style_zh: [主体]，风格派新造型主义平面设计，严格水平与垂直黑色分割线，非对称矩形比例模块，克制留白节奏，平涂三原色色块，利落现代主义抽象
prompts.composition: strict orthogonal horizontal-vertical grid, asymmetric modular balance / 严格正交水平垂直网格，非对称模块平衡
prompts.lighting: completely flat even illumination, zero photorealistic shadows / 完全平面均匀光照，无写实阴影
prompts.palette: primary red, yellow, blue with pure white, black and neutral gray / 红黄蓝三原色配纯白、黑与中性灰
prompts.negative: organic curves, diagonal chaos, photorealistic gradients, ornate decoration, busy textures / 有机曲线、杂乱斜线、写实渐变、繁复装饰、厚重纹理
prompts.compatibility: 通用；适合模块化海报与角色卡，避免过度抽象导致角色失真
prompts.tips: 区分 Mondrian 的严格正交体系与 Van Doesburg 的对角线实验；颜色用于划分平面而非渐变装饰

layout_tokens: strict orthogonal horizontal and vertical grid
palette_tokens: primary red, yellow, blue anchored by white, black and gray
treatment_tokens: geometric modular abstraction of background and framing
modular_tokens.identity_guard: keep character face and recognizable silhouette intact while abstracting surrounding panels

prompts.subject_example: 幻想风角色肖像海报 / 精装书封面
prompts.style_en: [subject], Art Nouveau decorative poster illustration, sinuous organic whiplash curves, botanical floral and vine framing integrated with subject, graceful flattened figure contour, lithographic print aesthetic
prompts.style_zh: [主体]，新艺术运动装饰海报插画，流动有机长弧线，植物花卉与藤蔓边框与主体嵌合，优雅平面化人物轮廓，彩色石版印刷质感
prompts.composition: central portrait integrated with flowing organic arch and floral border / 中心肖像与流动有机拱形花卉边框一体构图
prompts.lighting: soft flattened illustrative shading, gentle luminous contour / 柔和平面化插画明暗，温润轮廓线
prompts.palette: muted sage green, antique gold, warm ivory, dusty rose and deep burgundy / 柔和鼠尾草绿、古金、暖象牙白、烟粉与深酒红
prompts.negative: harsh neon colors, stiff geometric boxes, generic clip-art vines, face obscured by ornaments, photorealistic 3D / 刺眼霓虹、生硬几何框、廉价笔刷藤蔓、装饰遮挡面部、写实3D
prompts.compatibility: 通用；MJ / Flux 对石版插画表现极佳
prompts.tips: 边框应与人物发丝、衣摆形成呼应而非生硬套框；确保面部周围保留呼吸空间

layout_tokens: central iconic portrait with integrated organic arch framing
geometry_tokens: botanical vine and floral linear ornament
palette_tokens: muted sage green, antique gold, ivory and deep burgundy
modular_tokens.identity_guard: preserve exact facial features, hair color and costume insignia without ornament crowding the face

prompts.subject_example: 典藏级角色卡 / 奢华复古旅行海报
prompts.style_en: [subject], Art Deco graphic poster, monumental radial symmetry, stepped ziggurat borders, fan and chevron motifs, streamlined stylized silhouette, crisp geometric uppercase display frame
prompts.style_zh: [主体]，装饰艺术平面海报，纪念碑式放射对称构图，阶梯状几何边界，扇形与折线纹样，流线型简化轮廓，利落几何大写标题框架
prompts.composition: central symmetrical or radial focal point with stepped geometric border / 中心对称或放射焦点配阶梯几何边框
prompts.lighting: crisp dramatic directional highlights on metallic and lacquered edges / 金属与漆面边缘的利落戏剧性高光
prompts.palette: deep emerald green, antique brass gold, ivory and obsidian black (or cobalt blue and burgundy) / 浓祖母绿、古铜金、象牙白与曜石黑（或钴蓝配酒红）
prompts.negative: cluttered organic vines, sloppy hand-drawn lines, cheap all-gold filter, blurry low contrast / 杂乱有机藤蔓、松散手绘线、廉价全金滤镜、模糊低对比
prompts.compatibility: 通用；避免只用黑金，可加入祖母绿、钴蓝、酒红提升层次
prompts.tips: 扇形、阶梯与放射线最多同时使用两种，避免装饰争夺主体视觉焦点

palette_tokens: obsidian black, ivory, emerald green and restrained brass gold
material_tokens: lacquered finish, brushed metallic gold foil and fine lithograph paper
lighting_tokens: crisp dramatic rim highlights with sharp shadow edges
modular_tokens.identity_guard: keep facial structure and costume details recognizable while streamlining outer contours

prompts.subject_example: 活力角色周边海报 / 漫画风格专辑封面
prompts.style_en: [subject], Pop Art graphic print, bold black comic outlines, Ben-Day halftone dots, silkscreen color-block repetition, high-saturation primary colors, mass-media commercial print energy
prompts.style_zh: [主体]，波普艺术平面版画，粗黑漫画轮廓线，半色调网点，丝网印刷色块重复，高饱和原色对比，大众媒介商业印刷张力
prompts.composition: bold central commercial close-up or comic panel repetition with clean speech-bubble zone / 大胆商业特写或漫画分格重复，对话气泡分区
prompts.lighting: flat graphic high-contrast print lighting, crisp shadow blocks / 平面高反差印刷光影，利落暗部色块
prompts.palette: saturated cyan, magenta, process yellow and stark black ink / 高饱和青、洋红、明黄与纯黑油墨
prompts.negative: soft painterly realism, muddy desaturated tones, halftone covering eyes, unreadable gibberish comic text / 柔和写实油画、脏灰低饱和、网点遮挡眼睛、乱码漫画字
prompts.compatibility: 通用；拟声词和对话气泡建议后期排版
prompts.tips: 确保半色调网点避开眼睛和表情核心区域；使用大众符号时注意版权与肖像权

layout_tokens: comic panel division or bold Warhol-style repeated portrait grid
palette_tokens: high-saturation cyan, magenta, process yellow and stark black
modular_tokens.identity_guard: keep eyes, facial expression and character markers crisp and free of heavy halftone noise

prompts.subject_example: 清澈科技感 AI 角色海报 / 未来交互概念视觉
prompts.style_en: [subject], Frutiger Aero aesthetic, bright optimistic futuristic atmosphere, clear blue sky and lush aqua green accents, glossy translucent glass bubbles, crisp water droplets, airy open composition
prompts.style_zh: [主体]，Frutiger Aero 美学，明亮乐观的未来科技氛围，澄澈蓝天与青绿自然点缀，通透玻璃气泡，清澈水滴，开阔呼吸感构图
prompts.composition: open airy sky backdrop, layered floating translucent glass spheres and clean focal subject / 开阔通透天空背景，少量漂浮透明玻璃球与清晰主体分层
prompts.lighting: bright natural sunlight, crisp specular glass highlights, soft lens bloom / 明亮自然日光，清脆玻璃镜面高光，柔和光晕
prompts.palette: sky blue, aqua cyan, fresh grass green and luminous pure white / 天空蓝、水青、鲜草绿与通透纯白
prompts.negative: dark cyberpunk neon, heavy chrome grunge, muddy shadows, overexposed unreadable whiteout, cluttered UI / 暗黑赛博霓虹、厚重暗黑金属、浑浊阴影、过曝发白、杂乱界面
prompts.compatibility: 通用；适合科技海报、AI 虚拟角色与界面概念图
prompts.tips: 与 Y2K 区分：减少硬核铬金属与暗调赛博，强调蓝绿、水滴、阳光与透明玻璃的乐观感

layout_tokens: open airy composition with generous sky negative space
geometry_tokens: smooth spheres, bubbles, water droplets and soft rounded glass panels
palette_tokens: luminous sky blue, aqua cyan, fresh green and crisp white
lighting_tokens: bright optimistic daylight with clean specular highlights
modular_tokens.identity_guard: keep subject contrast readable against bright sky and translucent glass layers

prompts.subject_example: 数字音乐节海报 / 科幻媒介实验角色视觉
prompts.style_en: [subject], controlled Glitch Art visual, deliberate horizontal pixel slicing, subtle RGB channel displacement, scanlines and digital compression artifacts, sharp recognizable focal anchor
prompts.style_zh: [主体]，受控故障艺术视觉，有节制的水平像素切片，轻微 RGB 通道分离，扫描线与数字压缩伪影，保留清晰可辨的主体锚点
prompts.composition: clear focal subject anchored in frame with localized horizontal signal breaks / 画面保留稳固主体锚点，局部施加水平信号断裂与位移
prompts.lighting: screen-emitted high-contrast digital glow, crisp scanline modulation / 屏幕自发光高反差数字光效，清晰扫描线调制
prompts.palette: original subject palette accented by localized electric blue, magenta and acid green channel splits / 保留主体原色，局部点缀电光蓝、洋红与荧光绿通道分离
prompts.negative: random unreadable noise, distorted melting face, broken anatomy, full-frame static snow, illegible typography / 随机杂乱噪点、脸部融化变形、结构崩坏、全屏雪花、难读文字
prompts.compatibility: 通用；关键文字放在独立未故障层后期排版
prompts.tips: 不要把随机噪点当成故障逻辑；保留清晰脸部与轮廓作为“错误”的视觉参照系

layout_tokens: anchored focal subject disrupted by selective horizontal signal slices
palette_tokens: source tones with localized RGB channel split accents
modular_tokens.identity_guard: keep eyes, facial identity and key silhouette undistorted; confine glitch artifacts to edges and background

prompts.subject_example: 概念艺术专辑封面 / 世界观叙事海报
prompts.style_en: [subject], Surrealist editorial collage, impossible scale juxtaposition, one central conceptual visual metaphor, seamless photographic and vintage print cutouts, dreamlike spatial dislocation, tactile paper grain
prompts.style_zh: [主体]，超现实主义编辑拼贴，不可能的尺度错置，一个核心概念视觉隐喻，摄影与复古印刷素材剪贴融合，梦境般空间错位，纸张触感颗粒
prompts.composition: one dominant conceptual metaphor with controlled negative space and spatial impossibility / 单一核心隐喻主导画面，克制留白与空间错位
prompts.lighting: unified directional soft daylight harmonizing heterogeneous cutout sources / 统一柔和方向光融合异质拼贴素材
prompts.palette: curated muted archival palette unifying disparate photographic fragments / 克制复古档案色调统一异质素材
prompts.negative: random chaotic clipart pile, messy disconnected stickers, harsh neon 3D, amateur cutout halos / 随机素材堆砌、杂乱贴纸、刺眼3D霓虹、粗糙白边
prompts.compatibility: 通用；适合概念海报、杂志配图与世界观插画
prompts.tips: 先确定一个可解释的视觉隐喻，最多引入 1–2 个次级异质物体，避免无意义堆砌

palette_tokens: unified muted archival tones with one focal accent
lighting_tokens: unified dreamlike directional light across disparate elements
modular_tokens.identity_guard: preserve character identity while applying surreal scale shifts to surrounding space and props

prompts.subject_example: 分层剪纸角色海报 / 独立 Zine 封面
prompts.style_en: [subject], tactile cut-paper collage artwork, layered hand-cut and torn paper silhouettes, gouache painted paper shapes, subtle contact shadows between paper strata, scanned analog texture, restrained tape accents
prompts.style_zh: [主体]，触感剪纸拼贴作品，分层手剪与撕纸剪影，水粉彩绘色纸块面，纸层间细微接触阴影，模拟扫描纸张纹理，克制胶带点缀
prompts.composition: layered foreground-midground-background paper strata with crisp focal silhouette / 前中后分层纸片叠层，主体剪影清晰优先
prompts.lighting: soft overhead studio light casting subtle paper-edge contact shadows / 柔和顶光带出纸层边缘细微接触阴影
prompts.palette: limited flat gouache paper colors with one vivid accent sheet / 有限水粉色纸色板配单一高饱和强调色纸
prompts.negative: thick 3D plastic blocks, uniform fake torn edges everywhere, severed fingers or hair, glossy CGI / 厚重3D塑料板、千篇一律假撕边、裁断手指头发、高光CGI
prompts.compatibility: 通用；非常容易与 Swiss Grid 或 Pop Art 组合
prompts.tips: 剪切边缘必须避开头发细丝、手指与面部关键特征；不要让所有边缘都用同一种撕纸纹理

layout_tokens: layered cutout depth strata with clear silhouette hierarchy
geometry_tokens: varied crisp-cut and torn paper edges
palette_tokens: limited matte painted paper tones plus one bold accent
lighting_tokens: soft flat studio light with delicate paper-layer contact shadows
modular_tokens.identity_guard: protect hair silhouette, fingers and facial contours from rough cutout tears

prompts.subject_example: 实验文化展海报 / 独立杂志专题封面
prompts.style_en: [subject], Brutalist graphic design poster, raw stark typographic blocks, hard edge cropping, exposed coarse grid structure, high-contrast black and white with pure RGB blue accent, unpolished print immediacy
prompts.style_zh: [主体]，野兽派平面设计海报，原始粗粝排版块面，硬性边缘裁切，暴露粗重网格构造，高反差黑白配纯 RGB 蓝强调色，低修饰印刷直白感

prompts.palette: stark black, raw white, concrete gray with single pure RGB blue or acid accent / 纯黑、生白、灰配单一纯 RGB 蓝或荧光强调色
prompts.negative: generic concrete building photo, unreadable chaotic mess, soft cute gradients, glossy 3D icons / 泛滥混凝土建筑照片、不可读混乱堆砌、柔和可爱渐变、高光3D图标
prompts.compatibility: 通用；主体文字与编号建议后期在排版软件完成
prompts.tips: 不要把“丑陋或无法阅读”当成野兽派定义，也不要硬塞混凝土照片；正文必须保持独立可读层级

palette_tokens: high-contrast monochrome with single pure RGB blue accent
material_tokens: harsh xerox or offset ink grain
modular_tokens.identity_guard: crop frame decisively without severing face or primary character identity markers

prompts.subject_example: 几何构成角色海报 / 现代设计展主视觉
prompts.style_en: [subject], Bauhaus modernist graphic design, elementary circle triangle and square geometric decomposition, functional balanced grid, crisp flat primary colors, clean sans-serif modernist aesthetic
prompts.style_zh: [主体]，包豪斯现代主义平面设计，圆形三角形方形基础几何构成拆解，功能性平衡网格，利落平涂三原色，简洁无衬线现代主义美学
prompts.composition: functional asymmetric geometric balance built from primary shapes / 由基础几何形构成的功能性非对称平衡
prompts.lighting: clean even flat graphic lighting / 干净均匀平面光照
prompts.palette: bauhaus red, yellow, cobalt blue on warm off-white and charcoal black / 包豪斯红、黄、钴蓝配暖米白与炭黑

prompts.tips: 用基础几何模块转译发束、衣摆或背景，不要把人物本身彻底打散成不可辨认的色块

geometry_tokens: elementary circle, triangle and square modules
geometric decomposition of garments and hair
palette_tokens: Bauhaus red, yellow, cobalt blue with off-white and charcoal
modular_tokens.identity_guard: decompose only peripheral shapes into geometric modules while keeping face and proportions intact

prompts.subject_example: 年轻潮牌活动海报 / 活泼播客封面
prompts.style_en: [subject], Memphis Group postmodern graphic design, playful geometric squiggles, polka dots, terrazzo patterns, bold clashing flat colors, energetic asymmetric arrangement
prompts.style_zh: [主体]，孟菲斯后现代平面设计，玩味几何波浪线、波点与水磨石纹样，大胆撞色平涂色块，活力非对称排布

palette_tokens: bold pastel-and-bright clashing palette with black-and-white stripes
lighting_tokens: bright flat lighting with crisp graphic shadows

prompts.subject_example: 独立书店展览海报 / 复古插画专辑封面
prompts.style_en: [subject], Risograph art print, limited 3-spot fluorescent soy-ink palette, subtle intentional misregistration, tactile grainy stencil halftone texture, warm uncoated cream paper stock
prompts.style_zh: [主体]，Risograph 孔版印刷艺术版画，限制 3 种荧光大豆油墨专色，轻微刻意套印错位，触感颗粒网点肌理，暖色无涂布米白纸张

prompts.subject_example: 复古电子音乐封面 / 怀旧数字艺术海报
prompts.style_en: [subject], Vaporwave retro-digital aesthetic, dreamlike sunset pastel pink and cyan gradient, 1990s computer graphics nostalgia, subtle VHS scanlines, classic marble or wireframe accents
prompts.style_zh: [主体]，蒸汽波复古数字美学，梦幻粉紫与青色日落渐变，1990 年代早期电脑图形怀旧感，细微 VHS 扫描线，克制石膏或线框点缀
prompts.composition: dreamy horizon perspective grid or retro window framing around central subject / 梦幻地平线透视网格或复古窗口围绕中心主体
prompts.lighting: soft nostalgic neon pink and turquoise rim glow, hazy twilight atmosphere / 柔和怀旧粉青轮廓霓虹光，朦胧黄昏氛围
prompts.palette: pastel magenta, sunset coral, electric turquoise and twilight violet / 粉紫、日落珊瑚、电光青与暮光紫
prompts.negative: grim military realism, muddy brown tones, overstuffed cliché meme collage / 写实军事灰暗、浑浊棕色调、廉价梗图堆砌
prompts.compatibility: 通用；避免把石膏像、棕榈树、日文假名、Win95 窗口全部塞进同一画面
prompts.tips: 从蒸汽波符号库中每次只选 1–2 个元素（例如渐变+线框），防止沦为刻板模板

layout_tokens: retro-digital horizon grid or nostalgic framed composition
palette_tokens: nostalgic pastel pink, twilight violet and turquoise gradient
lighting_tokens: soft magenta and cyan twilight rim glow
modular_tokens.identity_guard: keep character face clear of heavy VHS distortion and preserve authentic skin/hair cues

prompts.subject_example: 美术馆特展海报 / 生活方式器物主视觉
prompts.style_en: [subject], Japanese minimalist graphic design, serene Ma negative space, delicate asymmetrical balance, natural warm washi paper texture, restrained fine typography, wabi-sabi quietness
prompts.style_zh: [主体]，日式极简平面设计，宁静的“間”留白呼吸感，克制非对称平衡，温润和纸自然肌理，纤细克制排版，侘寂静谧氛围
prompts.composition: generous intentional Ma negative space, serene asymmetric placement / 大面积有意留白（間），宁静非对称落位
prompts.lighting: soft diffused natural window daylight, gentle quiet shadows / 柔和漫射自然窗光，轻柔静谧阴影
prompts.palette: warm off-white washi, charcoal sumi ink, muted timber beige and one subtle earth accent / 暖白和纸、炭墨黑、柔和原木米色配单一大地色点缀
prompts.negative: loud neon colors, cluttered elements, heavy 3D gloss, aggressive drop shadows / 刺眼霓虹、拥挤元素、厚重3D高光、生硬重阴影
prompts.compatibility: 通用；适合建筑、器物、展览与高端生活方式品牌
prompts.tips: 留白不是空白偷懒，需要用纸张肌理、自然光影或精准比例建立温度，避免显得冰冷

palette_tokens: warm washi off-white, sumi charcoal and muted natural earth tone
lighting_tokens: soft diffused natural daylight with gentle shadows
modular_tokens.identity_guard: let subject breathe cleanly in negative space without over-stylizing natural proportions

prompts.subject_example: 独立游戏角色宣传图 / 温暖绘本风品牌海报
prompts.style_en: [subject], expressive hand-drawn editorial illustration, tactile ink linework and textured gouache washes, warm organic brushwork, charming imperfect human craft, matte watercolor paper grain
prompts.style_zh: [主体]，表现力手绘编辑插画，有温度的墨线勾勒与水粉质感笔触，自然有机涂色，迷人的手工细节，哑光水彩纸纹理
prompts.composition: inviting narrative framing with breathing room for hand-lettered or clean editorial title / 富有叙事感的亲和构图，为标题留出呼吸空间
prompts.lighting: warm natural illustrative daylight, gentle painted color shadows / 温暖自然插画日光，柔和手绘色彩阴影
prompts.palette: warm earthy terracotta, sage green, mustard ochre and soft cream paper / 温暖陶土红、鼠尾草绿、芥末黄与柔和米白纸底
prompts.negative: sterile corporate vector art, glossy plastic 3D, harsh mechanical perfection, inconsistent style mix / 冰冷商务矢量、高光塑料3D、僵硬机械感、画风割裂
prompts.compatibility: 通用；极易与 Organic、Japanese Minimalism 或 Editorial 组合
prompts.tips: 明确指定单一画材（如水粉、彩铅或钢笔淡彩），避免同时混用多种冲突笔触导致画风割裂

palette_tokens: warm terracotta, sage green, ochre and cream paper
treatment_tokens: hand-crafted linework and painterly color washes
modular_tokens.identity_guard: maintain consistent character facial likeness and costume details across hand-drawn brushwork
